query:
UPDATE propertyvalues AS p
               SET value = v.value::jsonb,
                   deleteat = v.deleteat,
                   updateat = $5,
                   updatedby = v.updatedby
              FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[], $3::bigint[], $4::text[])
                   AS v(id, value, deleteat, updatedby)
             WHERE p.id = v.id
               AND ($6 = '' OR p.groupid = $6)
